text:
Lena Park: Heads up — all-hands at 09:30am PT today. High-level agenda: 1) company health & a few numbers; 2) Dedicated capacity rollout update; 3) new hosted usage quota policy overview + migration options; 4) Console observability demo; 5) live Q&A. If you can, drop one sentence questions here or use the form: https://forms.redwood-inference/c/allhands-asks

Priya Rao: I'll cover the metrics slide and the hiring ask (2 infra, 1 sales ops).

Marco Li: quick question — the new quota policy, will it impact our partner trial accounts?

Lena Park: short answer: partner trials get a separate grace bucket for 60 days, then they default to opt-in unless they commit. We'll publish details in the migration guide after the meeting.

Sam (eng-sre): ops note: if hosted quota enforcement flips on for a customer we should have an alert and a rollback flag. Tagging eng-sre to coordinate runbooks.

Ivy (Legal): please keep me looped on the customer notice text. For EU-regulated customers we may need extra notice windows.

ops-bot: Reminder: all-hands starts in 10 minutes — join: https://meet.redwood-inference/allhands-3167890123

--- meeting occurred ---

Lena Park: Thanks for coming. Recording is up: https://redwood-inference.company/recordings/allhands-3167890123. Slides: https://redwood-inference.company/slides/allhands-3167890123.pdf

Priya Rao: Key takeaways: (a) focus on latency reductions in Q3, (b) push Private sales play for healthcare/finance, (c) hire for infra and solutions.

Marco Li: follow-up re: partners — we'll provide a partner-migration path doc by Tue with exact quota buckets and API flags.

Sam (eng-sre): ops follow-ups: create a quota-enforcement alert, add a canary rollout flag, update incident runbook by 2025-04-10.

Ivy (Legal): I'll review the customer messaging draft by Friday and call out any EU-required changes.

Lena Park: ACTIONS — Lena to publish migration guide (Tue); Priya to send hiring note to execs (Mon); Marco to post partner migration doc (Tue); Sam to update runbooks + alerts (2025-04-10); Ivy to approve messaging (Fri).

Marco Li: follow-up: partner edge cases — will list in the doc.

Priya Rao: follow-up: hiring reqs include IC and manager levels, will attach JD.

ops-bot: Transcript and auto-generated notes available: https://redwood-inference.company/transcripts/allhands-3167890123

Lena Park: Thanks — if you need a deeper sync on any item reply with "follow-up: <topic>" and we'll assign. Closing thread.
